about: Owner decisions Q5 and Q11 (17 Oct). Each project names the surface its proof must come from, the release read-back its app builds need, and the shared test servers its crews lease one at a time. A PR belongs to the project whose repos list its repository (owner/repo, * is a wildcard); a crew belongs to the project whose repos list its repository or whose bbProjects list its BB project name. hostCanDrive lists the surfaces a crew on this host can drive itself; for any other surface the crew asks the owner to test the build, and his Works tap is the proof record.

surfaces.iphone: the app on an iPhone or the iOS Simulator
surfaces.web: the deployed web page in a browser
surfaces.message: a real message through the changed channel

sharedServers.reset: deploy main back to the dev server
